title: J'mall opens a chapter of depth with new single "Peripheral"
htmlContent: With his latest single "Peripheral," the first look at an upcoming release titled LP, "More That Meets The Eye," J'mall fearlessly takes a dip in introspection. "Peripheral" refers to the edges of things we don't pay much attention to, the wisdom, growth, and love that exist beyond material distractions. Writing since the age of eight, J'mall brings a mature emotional sensibility to the table. "Peripheral" carries a meditative weight, inviting a moment to pause and look beyond the immediately clear. The song is lush, warm, meditative, and filled with texture. J'mall's pacing is slow and soulful, slowly guiding you aboard a train of awareness and gratitude. https://open.spotify.com/track/0Ye0lnsWlBcNB4Rc7RA56T "Peripheral" also acts as a teaser of J'mall's broader creative scope. The new LP promises to address themes of family, wisdom, and personal growth, which are imperative aspects of life. This single captures that vibe perfectly, keeping it real and emotional. The most apparent aspect of J'mall's music is his substance. "Peripheral" is evidence that introspection can feel powerful, that truth can groove, and that artistry continues to have the capacity not only to entertain but also to enlighten. J'mall is inviting us to widen our focus, not just to what's directly in front of us, but to the meaningful actions and life waiting for us on the edge. Follow J'mall on Instagram
